items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 48:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Mochin of ZA are drawn from the AB that is upon the Mazal, which is the aspect of the first restriction and harsh Din; but when they are in the place of the coupling in the head, they are sweetened. However, in his NHY, which are the ten Sefirot of the end, the Dinim are found revealed there, as above in Answer 35.
